vlog_arc.theme: The infrastructure week: building the systems that let everything else work.

beats.mon: It's Monday, 5AM, and before I open my laptop or check anything, I want to talk about what I mean when I say Power Coffee is infrastructure — not a supplement, not a wellness product — infrastructure, and this week I'm going to show you exactly what I mean.
beats.tue: I pulled the numbers from last week and two pipeline gaps cost us more reach than any content decision did, so today I'm fixing the structure before I touch the copy — because no pattern in the content works if the pipe is broken.
beats.wed: I've been drinking my own formula for 430 mornings now, and I want to show you what that actually looks like mid-week — not a before-and-after, just the 2PM window where the crash used to hit and now doesn't.
beats.thu: Spent an hour today with the Ginkgo research that went into the formula — not for content, but because I want to understand what I'm selling at a level most founders never go to — and I think that's the only honest way to build something that lasts.
beats.fri: Friday means Gabriel and Helena get the evening, and the reason I can be fully present at 6PM is the same reason I built this formula — I needed the 5AM through 5PM to actually work so the rest of it could be real.
beats.sat: No agenda today — just me, the formula, a training block, and one honest reflection: I used to think building in public meant sharing wins, but I'm realizing it means showing the structure you're building so others can steal what works.
beats.sun: Before the week resets, I want to say this: faith and family are not the things I fit around the business — they're the reason the business has to work, and every ingredient in this formula, every 5AM, is in service of that, not the other way around.
